build_StrandCodec: build a StrandCodec model with VAE encoding and SIREN decoding for hair strand generation
create_StrandEncoder1dCNN: create a 1D CNN strand encoder that encodes hair strand points into latent shape vectors
create_StrandGeneratorSiren: create a SIREN-based strand generator that decodes latent vectors into 3D hair strand points
run_StrandCodec_forward: run the StrandCodec forward pass to encode and decode hair strand data with spline interpolation
test_StrandCodec_compute_loss: test the StrandCodec loss computation combining L2 position, direction cosine, and KL divergence losses
